programme.desc: S7 E7 — Episode 7 Paul and Nicole of the Special Operations Response Team are called after a mobility scooter plunges down a steep embankment. The crew work closely with fire and rescue to lower a paramedic down by rope to administer vital pain relief to the patient. Thoughts then turn to how the emergency services can get the patient to safety. In Edinburgh, teammates Kevin and Martyn respond to a 999 call from a concerned member of the public after a man is found unconscious in the city centre. They arrive to find that the patient is a familiar face - a homeless man with an alcohol dependency, and who is a frequent user of the ambulance service. Not long after taking this unfortunate patient to hospital, the team receive another 999 call - the same man has been found passed out in the street, having absconded from A&E. The crew now face the dilemma of how to best treat this struggling person.
programme.title: Paramedics On Scene

programme.desc: S7 E8 — Episode 8 John and Craig of the Special Operations Response Team are called to Glasgow city centre, where a public brawl has broken out on a busy Saturday evening. At the scene, John helps to coordinate the ambulance response, engaging with police to help keep the two factions separate. Meanwhile, Craig treats someone who was caught up in the melee. The next morning, ambulance crew Jim and Kire are called to a church in the south of the city. The patient is Ian, a member of the congregation who has collapsed complaining of chest pain. When the team get Ian into the back of their ambulance, they carry out an ECG of his heart, which gives some concerning readings. Thirty miles away in Livingston, ambulance crew Aaron and Alex are called to see George, who has been found on the pavement close to his home after struggling with his speech and mobility for the past year. Although George hasn’t been injured in the fall, the team need to make sure he is safe to be left on his own.
programme.title: Paramedics On Scene

programme.desc: S7 E23 — Inferno: Episode 5 In the parallel world, Earth’s crust has been penetrated, releasing terrible forces from within the Earth. The Doctor must escape back to his world to prevent the same catastrophe.

programme.desc: S8 E6 — The Mind of Evil: Episode 2 A full scale riot takes place at the Prison and Jo is taken hostage. Meanwhile, at the World Peace conference, the Chinese delegate’s aid prepares to kill the American delegate.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S8 E7 — The Mind of Evil: Episode 3 The Master is behind the Keller Machine and uses it to recruit the rioting inmates at Stangmoor Prison. He plans to capture a missile and fire it at the World Peace Conference.

programme.desc: S8 E8 — The Mind of Evil: Episode 4 The mind parasite within the Keller Machine becomes too powerful for the Master to control. It learns how to move of its own accord and goes on the hunt for new minds.

programme.desc: S8 E9 — The Mind of Evil: Episode 5 The Master forms an uneasy alliance with the Doctor so that between them they can subdue the Keller Machine which is now out of control.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S8 E12 — The Claws of Axos: Episode 2 The Master is in league with the Axons who intend to consume the Earth. The Doctor subjects Axonite to tests and discovers the terrible truth.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S8 E13 — The Claws of Axos: Episode 3 The Axons reveal their true nature and attempt to obtain the secret of time travel. Meanwhile, the Master, forced to work for UNIT, concocts a plan to strike back at Axos.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S8 E14 — The Claws of Axos: Episode 4 With Axos poised to destroy the world, the Doctor appears to switch sides and allies himself with the Master. Together they plan to escape the Earth, leaving it to Axos.

programme.desc: S1 E8 — The Daleks: The Ambush Pretending to be a Dalek, Ian finds that that he is trapped inside the casing. The Doctor, Susan and Barbara have no choice but to abandon Ian as the real Daleks arrive and attack.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E5 — The Daleks: The Dead Planet The travellers venture out on to the surface of a new world. Everything is dead but beyond a petrified jungle they see a huge metal city which the Doctor is determined to explore.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E7 — The Daleks: The Escape Fearful of a Thal attack, the Daleks force Susan to trick the Thals. Realising that the Daleks are planning an ambush, the four travellers try to escape and warn the Thals.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E9 — The Daleks: The Expedition Ian and Barbara join a Thal expedition that will penetrate the Dalek city from the unguarded mountains behind it. Their journey is a dangerous one and not all will survive.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E10 — The Daleks: The Ordeal The Doctor and Susan are once again taken prisoner by the Daleks. In the mountains, Ian, Barbara and the Thals must negotiate a vast chasm to reach the city.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E11 — The Daleks: The Rescue The Thals and the time travellers attack the Daleks from all sides as the Daleks start the countdown to release deadly doses of radiation into the atmosphere.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E6 — The Daleks: The Survivors Looking for Barbara, the Doctor, Ian and Susan discover that they have exposed to lethal doses of radiation. The travellers are confronted by the city’s inhabitants – the Daleks!
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E13 — The Edge of Destruction: The Brink of Disaster As the power of the TARDIS threatens to escape and destroy the ship, the travellers become increasingly paranoid and hostile towards each other.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E12 — The Edge of Destruction: The Edge of Destruction The TARDIS is suspended in space and the Doctor, Ian, Barbara and Susan are confused and frightened by a series of inexplicable events.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E25 — The Keys of Marinus: Sentence of Death Arriving in the city of Millennius, Ian is put on trial for murder. The Doctor takes on the role of defence counsel and must prove Ian's innocence or he will be executed.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E26 — The Keys of Marinus: The Keys of Marinus The Doctor solves the murder mystery and finds the final missing key. With Ian now free, the travellers return to the island only to discover that Arbitan has been murdered.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E23 — The Keys of Marinus: The Screaming Jungle Ian and Barbara find a temple in the middle of a hostile jungle. Inside is the ailing Darrius, keeper of one of the keys. As Darrius dies he gives Ian a clue to find the key.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E21 — The Keys of Marinus: The Sea of Death The TARDIS lands on a remote island, surrounded by a sea of acid. They meet Arbitan, keeper of the Conscience of Marinus who forces the travellers to go in search of five keys.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S1 E24 — The Keys of Marinus: The Snows of Terror In a snowy wasteland, Vasor, an unscrupulous trapper, imprisons the travellers in a frozen cavern inside a mountain. There they find one of the keys frozen in a block of ice.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E9 — The Dalek Invasion of Earth: Flashpoint Ian attempts to derail the Daleks’ plan by sabotaging their bomb. The Doctor also works to undermine the Daleks by turning their Robomen slaves against them.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E5 — The Dalek Invasion of Earth: The Daleks The Daleks have conquered the Earth. Susan and Barbara have joined the human resistance who launch an attack on the Dalek flying saucer where the Doctor and Ian are prisoners.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E7 — The Dalek Invasion of Earth: The End of Tomorrow The Doctor, Barbara and Susan make their way out of London to the Daleks’ mining operation in Bedfordshire whilst Ian faces the Black Dalek’s pet Slyther.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E8 — The Dalek Invasion of Earth: The Waking Ally Barbara is put to work in the Dalek mine where it is revealed that the Daleks intend to use a bomb to extract the Earth’s magnetic core.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E4 — The Dalek Invasion of Earth: World's End The TARDIS lands in a ruined and empty London in the 22nd Century. Robomen patrol the shattered streets. The Doctor is eager to discover the cause of the city’s plight.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E11 — The Rescue: Desperate Measures Ian and Barbara discover that the paralysed Bennett has gone missing from his cabin. The Doctor discovers the truth about Koquillion, but endangers his own life in doing so.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E10 — The Rescue: The Powerful Enemy Arriving on the planet Dido, the Doctor, Barbara and Ian discover a crashed spaceship from Earth and survivors. They are terrorised by the monstrous Koquillion who attacks Barbara.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E13 — The Romans: All Roads Lead to Rome Barbara is sold as a slave and Ian is to be trained as a gladiator. The Doctor and Vicki arrive at the Emperor’s court with the Doctor still masquerading as Maximus Pettulian.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E14 — The Romans: Conspiracy Poppaea plans to poison Barbara who has become the object of Nero’s affections. The Doctor is to be thrown to the lions, Ian and Delos are set against each other in the arena.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E15 — The Romans: Inferno Inspired by the Doctor, Nero sets Rome ablaze. Ian must fight his way out of the arena and rescue Barbara. The Doctor and Vicki hurry to flee the city and escape to the TARDIS.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E12 — The Romans: The Slave Traders After relaxing at a Roman villa the Doctor is mistaken for a murdered lyre player and targeted by an assassin. Meanwhile, Ian and Barbara are captured by slave traders.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E18 — The Web Planet: Escape to Danger The alien intelligence, the Animus, coerces the Doctor to track down the invading Menoptra. Ian escapes the Carsinome and joins forces with Vrestin, but the Zarbi are in pursuit.

programme.desc: S2 E21 — The Web Planet: The Centre The Menoptra attack the Carsinome and the Doctor and his friends come face-to-face with the Animus. The Isop-Top device is their only hope of destroying the alien creature.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E17 — The Web Planet: The Zarbi Rescued by the Menoptra, Barbara is then captured by the ant-like Zarbi. The Doctor and Ian trace the missing TARDIS to a giant web city and encounter a mysterious intelligence.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E27 — The Space Museum: The Dimensions of Time Back on the proper time track, the travellers take steps to change the future. A rebel force of native Xerons are plotting against the invading Moroks who have captured the Doctor.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E29 — The Space Museum: The Final Phase After forcing Lobos to revive the Doctor, Ian is also taken prisoner. The Xeron rebellion is underway whilst the fate of the Doctor and his friends still hangs in the balance.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E28 — The Space Museum: The Search As events escalate, the travellers fear that they will not be able to escape their fate. Vicki helps orchestrate a raid on the Moroks’ armoury. Ian attempts to rescue the Doctor.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E26 — The Space Museum: The Space Museum Exploring a museum on the planet Xeros, the travellers discover they are invisible. The Doctor deduces that the TARDIS has jumped a time track and they are seeing their own future.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E32 — The Chase: Flight through Eternity The Daleks pursue the TARDIS through time and space. In an attempt to lose the Daleks, the Doctor makes a stop on the top of the Empire State Building and then on a sailing ship.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E33 — The Chase: Journey into Terror With the Daleks in pursuit, the TARDIS lands in what appears to be a haunted house. When the Daleks arrive, the travellers depart, not realising that they have left Vicki behind!
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E34 — The Chase: The Death of Doctor Who The Daleks follow the TARDIS to the jungle world of Mechanus, infested with lethal plants. There, the Daleks release a robot double of the Doctor that is programmed to kill.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E31 — The Chase: The Death of Time The Doctor and his friends have been given shelter from the Daleks by the Aridians. But the Daleks threaten to kill the Aridians unless they hand over the time travellers.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E30 — The Chase: The Executioners Ian and Vicki are trapped by tentacled creatures on the planet Aridius. The Doctor and Barbara witness Daleks leaving Skaro on a mission to eliminate the Doctor and his companions.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S2 E35 — The Chase: The Planet of Decision The Doctor and his friends are taken prisoner by the Mechonoids. There they meet fellow prisoner, Steven Taylor. The Daleks break into the Mechonoid city and a battle commences.
